Container.Name: AdGuardHub
Container.Overview: One dashboard to manage several AdGuard Home instances as a single system. AdGuardHub holds the filtering rules, blocklist subscriptions and instance settings, and pushes every change to all connected instances at once, so two instances kept for DNS failover can no longer overwrite each other's whitelist.
Container.Requires: The host port is 80, which assumes this container gets its own address from a custom network such as br0. On the default bridge network Unraid's own web interface holds port 80, so change the WebUI Port below before starting it there. PUID and PGID must match the owner of the appdata directory; on Unraid that is 99 and 100, which is preset. Leaving ADGUARDHUB_SECRET_KEY empty is supported: the hub then generates a key on first start and keeps it in the data volume, so stored AdGuard credentials survive updates. Setting it puts the key outside the directory it protects, which is the better option.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the AdGuardHub web interface. The container always listens on 80 internally.

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Persistent database, encrypted AdGuard credentials and the generated secret key.

Config.Name: ADGUARDHUB_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Signs session cookies and derives the key that encrypts stored AdGuard credentials. Generate with openssl rand -base64 48. Leave empty to let the hub create one inside the data volume on first start.

Config.Name: ADGUARDHUB_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Creates the admin account on first start. Leave empty to create it in the web interface on the first visit instead.

Config.Name: ADGUARDHUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the admin account created on first start. Only read together with the username above.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that should own the data volume. On Unraid this is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that should own the data volume. On Unraid this is 100.

Config.Name: ADGUARDHUB_RECONCILE_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between full reconciliation runs against every instance.

Config.Name: ADGUARDHUB_RETRY_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between retries for an instance that was unreachable.

Config.Name: ADGUARDHUB_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Set to DEBUG for per-instance diagnostics while chasing a misbehaving node.
